series.title: JavaScript
stages: Integrating and verifying the experiment log

series.title: React
stages: Performance verification and an integrated editor

units.title: String input and number conversion
units.goal: Record the validation result and type of all four inputs. The saved count does not increase for whitespace or negative numbers.
units.exampleNote: Compare editable inputs with actual browser execution results.

units.title: The box model and measured dimensions
units.goal: Record the actual widths of both cards. Distinguish the content, padding, border, and margin regions in the tools.
units.exampleNote: Change box-sizing to border-box and compare the measured widths of 244px and 200px. Document body/html selectors are scoped inside the Shadow DOM. @media responds to the outer preview viewport, while the width slider changes only the container. Network access, form navigation, and iframe execution are restricted.

units.title: Events and state snapshots
units.goal: Display 3 after functional updates starting from 0. Record the results of the plain-value update control separately.
units.exampleNote: This experiment uses the actual React API. It uses createElement instead of JSX.

units.title: Starting and target values
units.goal: Learning outcome: explain the roles of from and to. Input case: a card initially at x=40. Output: a transform table immediately after creation and after completion. Connect your explanation of initial application to the code.
units.exampleNote: This experiment explores starting and target values. You can manipulate it directly, and it cleans up the resources it uses.
